name: DeityBody — Trika phonemic-body operating system
principle: Abhinavagupta/Trika is the operating system (embodied phonemic ontology). Bruno is the combinatorial memory machinery. Goswami is a tool. Never learn a sound as an abstract letter — learn it as a coordinated event: glyph + articulation + felt vibration + body-location + imaginal signature.

textual_spine.role: Essential Trika scripture for Mātṛkā/Mālinī order and nyāsa
CANONICAL practice spine — volume Dyczkowski corpus on attached disk
Practice grammar; varṇa-uccāra; phonemes developed from powers (anuttara, ānanda, icchā, unmeṣa)
Mālinī order explained at madhyamā-vāc; vowel–consonant interpenetration as Śakti-body
Self-executing techniques; breath axis; phoneme resonance; void/gap awareness

borrow_for: contracting complex visualization into a point
do_not: replace Mātṛkā/Mālinī phonemic anatomy with Goswami chakra chart
make 1:4:2 a prerequisite for nyāsa training
goswami_role.later_overlay: bhūta/cakra = elemental-axial body; investigate superimposition only after phonemic body is stable

training_target: visual + phonetic + respiratory + tactile + attentional embodiment of Sanskrit
core_move: क → /ka/ → articulation → bodily location → Devanāgarī glyph → felt resonance → place in larger Śakti-body
success_signal: hearing or thinking 'ka' fires glyph + articulation + bodily location simultaneously

breath_policy.matrika_practice: let phonation naturally lengthen the exhalation; do not force 1:4:2 while memorizing locations
breath_policy.separate_pranayama: established 1:4:2 may continue separately if completely comfortable
breath_policy.authority: TĀ 4.91 — prāṇāyāma that torments the body is not to be practised
breath_policy.vbt_carrier: saḥ (out) / haṃ (in) heart ↔ dvādaśānta — comfortable breath only, no heroic retention

end_state: Mālinī interpenetrates order into Śākta body
mental phonemes contract toward undifferentiated śabdarāśi
sound and body recognized as modes of awareness, not external things

boundaries.color_chakra_chart: PEDAGOGICAL scaffold only; primary visual object is the Devanāgarī glyph
boundaries.goddess_names_in_nyasa: source-attested in TĀ/MV apparatus; optional for secular phonemic training

supplies: imaginal signatures that teach phonetic properties
bruno_role.historical_note: Bruno and Abhinavagupta had no historical connection. Synthetic pedagogy only.
bruno_role.warburg: De umbris wheels as phonetic encoding of foreign words (Sturlese/Warburg) — combinatorial vividness borrowed, not a Trika lineage claim
bruno_role.rule: The image must teach the property. Never invent mnemonics harder than the Sanskrit itself.

learning_direction: shape → movement → sound → bodily pattern → imaginal pattern → semantic field

texts_extra.role: Abhinavagupta on madhyamā-vāc / Mālinī / phonemes as powers

adds: entextualisation — body becomes text through tradition inscribed on it
mantra = sonic form of deity; japa = body-formation
epistemic caveats: no reification; late cakras; source-specificity

epistemic_hygiene.flood_law: The tantric body is constructed, not discovered. Maps are tradition-specific entextualisation, not biomedical anatomy.
locks: SOURCE_ATTESTED vs PEDAGOGICAL on every map
do not mix rites across texts
cakra charts are late/variable — not early Trika OS
Trika ritual = action within consciousness, not only muscle memory

pathway.governing_principle: Use learning Sanskrit itself as training in Abhinavagupta's model of consciousness.
pathway.nyasa_is: Reconstructing the biological body as the body of Śakti by installing the matrix from which articulated experience arises.
pathway.start: Phase 1 — chant phonemes at body points
pathway.endpoint: Pratyabhijñā recognition — powers are expressions of consciousness

integrated_theory.sadadhvan: varṇa↔kalā · mantra↔tattva · pada↔bhuvana — paired manifestations of consciousness
integrated_theory.aham: a=emergence · ha=terminal/Śakti · ṃ=bindu — master contraction/expansion rhythm
integrated_theory.spanda: consciousness dynamic → vāk → Mātṛkā → mantra → pada → world; laya reverses
integrated_theory.matrika_vs_malini: Mātṛkā=articulated order; Mālinī=Śakti's reconfiguration — permute only after stable
integrated_theory.overlays: Selectable projections — never one universal chakra chart
integrated_theory.sensory_deity: Senses offer objects to Bhairava — decompose experience into powers, recognize common source

starter.rule: Sound+articulation+touch+locus first; visualization after association stable
starter.upaya_note: Theory order anupāya→…→āṇava; practice order body/sound→recognition (āṇava first for embodiment)

common_confusion.issue: Chanting a while attending forehead naturally elongates into ā
common_confusion.rule: Mouth decides how it sounds. Locus decides where it is installed.
common_confusion.a_vs_aa: Same open quality; difference is duration (short tap vs held mātrās)
common_confusion.locus_role: Nyāsa install site — not articulatory place for the vowel
common_confusion.drill: short a on forehead · held ā on mouth/face · alternate without touch

canonical.decision: Tantrāloka (volume Dyczkowski corpus) = CANONICAL practice spine
